title: Power of the Market - The Pencil
summary: A three-minute excerpt from Milton Friedman's Free to Choose in which he uses a pencil to show that no single person knows how to make it. He argues that the free market coordinates countless strangers peacefully.
why: HN uses it as the canonical illustration of decentralized production and global cooperation, often cited well outside economics threads.

quote.text: There's not a single person in the world who could make this pencil.
